comparison_source.title: Campaign Layout Guide: Act 1
comparison_source.author: Lolcohol; Campaign Codex contributors
comparison_source.patch_status: Page warns of layout reworks in 0.5; not verified for target 0.5.5.
comparison_source.reuse: Original factual summaries; no source prose or diagrams redistributed.

entries.text: A waypoint sits right next to Mud Burrow; the bridge onward leads to The Grelwood

Lit pillar switch. The Forgotten Riches cache sits behind a large sarcophagus near a checkpoint. The hidden switch is on a nearby pillar and lights up as you approach it — that glow is the tell. Pure loot (gold + rare chests, no guaranteed item), and it is repeatable by resetting the zone from the waypoint.
In the illustrated layouts, Beira is north of the entrance. Mud Burrow and the Mysterious Campsite can exchange sides; do not assume a fixed left/right placement.
entries.patch_caveat: Mobalytics warns of 0.5 layout changes; patterns may differ in 0.5.5.

entries.text: Follow glowing roots toward the Tree of Souls. Follow the river to find the Red Vale entrance; the guide does not require a particular river-flow direction.
entries.patch_caveat: Mobalytics warns of 0.5 layout changes; patterns may differ in 0.5.5.

entries.text: Orange magical mushrooms mark the route to the Grim Tangle entrance. Major landmarks often form a diamond; use that as a search pattern if the visible trails run out.
entries.patch_caveat: Mobalytics warns of 0.5 layout changes; patterns may differ in 0.5.5.

entries.text: Try a broad loop while searching for the three Rust Altars. Their arrangement varies; there is no reliable fixed turn sequence in this source.
entries.patch_caveat: Mobalytics warns of 0.5 layout changes; patterns may differ in 0.5.5.

entries.text: Travel away from the entrance toward the side where the area opens up. The illustrated layouts put the exit opposite the entrance, with the pattern reversed for the other starting side.
entries.patch_caveat: Mobalytics warns of 0.5 layout changes; patterns may differ in 0.5.5.

entries.text: Search the side walls for both tomb entrances. Try the wall beside Lachlann first, then sweep the other side if needed; the source found no dependable tomb arrangement.
entries.patch_caveat: Mobalytics warns of 0.5 layout changes; patterns may differ in 0.5.5.

entries.text: Find the central wheel-shaped room, then search along the line from your entrance through that room toward the far wall. If Draven is absent, check the long wall aligned with the entrance. Ribbed arena edges can reveal his room.
entries.patch_caveat: Mobalytics warns of 0.5 layout changes; patterns may differ in 0.5.5.

entries.text: Try corridors toward the upper part of the area for Asinia, then widen the search. The guide records exceptions, including a central arena, so this is only a search preference.
entries.patch_caveat: Mobalytics warns of 0.5 layout changes; patterns may differ in 0.5.5.

entries.text: Check the outer edges and corners for exits and major landmarks. Follow the road sign toward Ogham Farmlands; bloody tracks and a narrow approach lead toward the Crowbell arena.
entries.patch_caveat: Mobalytics warns of 0.5 layout changes; patterns may differ in 0.5.5.

entries.text: If you complete the central ritual, follow its locust trail toward Freythorn. This is a detour clue, not a requirement to search the middle before taking another exit.
entries.patch_caveat: Mobalytics warns of 0.5 layout changes; patterns may differ in 0.5.5.

entries.text: After completing a ritual, look for locusts indicating the next nearby ritual. If no trail is visible, search in a loop. Do not rely on smoke at the boss arena: the guide marks that older clue as potentially obsolete.
entries.patch_caveat: Mobalytics warns of 0.5 layout changes; patterns may differ in 0.5.5.

entries.text: Look for a long hut with carts obstructing the approach; go around it to reach Una's hut and the Lute Box.
entries.patch_caveat: Mobalytics warns of 0.5 layout changes; patterns may differ in 0.5.5.

entries.text: Head away from the entrance toward the opposite boundary, then search that wall for Ogham Village. The illustrated variants rotate the same general pattern, so avoid a fixed compass heading.
entries.patch_caveat: Mobalytics warns of 0.5 layout changes; patterns may differ in 0.5.5.

entries.text: From the entrance, try following the right-hand boundary toward the northern boss area. For Renly's Tools, look for the checkpoint opening into a side room along the northern wall; if missed, search back from the waypoint.
entries.patch_caveat: Mobalytics warns of 0.5 layout changes; patterns may differ in 0.5.5.

entries.text: Follow the U-shaped route toward Ogham Manor. The pattern can be mirrored; an early dead end is a reason to reverse your search rather than force a fixed compass direction.
entries.patch_caveat: Mobalytics warns of 0.5 layout changes; patterns may differ in 0.5.5.

entries.text: Floor 1: cross the bridge and search the northern boundary for Candlemass. Entrance and stair positions can swap, so locate the stairs to floor 2 relative to your actual entrance rather than always heading northeast.
entries.patch_caveat: Mobalytics warns of 0.5 layout changes; patterns may differ in 0.5.5.

entries.text: Floor 2: search across the bridge, generally away from your entrance, for the stairs onward. Some layouts loop rather than forming a direct crossing.
entries.patch_caveat: Mobalytics warns of 0.5 layout changes; patterns may differ in 0.5.5.

entries.text: Floor 3: look across the area from your entrance for the bridge toward the Count, then use the elevator to reach the fight. Floor hints are conditional; the app does not detect your floor.
entries.patch_caveat: Mobalytics warns of 0.5 layout changes; patterns may differ in 0.5.5.
